# Contributing

Keep each change focused on a demonstrated skill behavior. Put deployable content
under `skills/`, operator guidance under `docs/`, and evaluation evidence under
`evals/`. Use the [evaluation report template](../templates/evaluation-report.md).

Run `pre-commit run --all-files` and the changed skill's validation before review.
Keep literal commands and source facts intact in writing cases. Report whether
checks were static, author self-review, or independent model evaluations.

Use draft pull requests during development. Do not upload credentials, session
transcripts, personal drafts, or installed-skill backups. Use synthetic inputs.
Retain upstream notices when adapting source material.
